0022600040.text: The San Antonio Spurs (9-2) host the Golden State Warriors (8-3) in the 13th game of their season, with the Spurs on a nine-game winning streak, 5-0 on the road, and 1st in the Southwest. Golden State enters on an eight-game winning streak and sits 2nd in the Pacific, 1.5 games back, and 3rd in the West. San Antonio is missing Devin Vassell (groin), Jayden Quaintance (knee, surgery), and Tobias Harris (calf strain), while Golden State is without Brandon Williams (hamstring), Gary Payton II (knee inflammation), Jimmy Butler III (knee, surgery), Kristaps Porzingis (illness), and Moses Moody (knee, surgery). The teams have not met yet in 2026-27 after splitting their 2025-26 series 2-2, and the Spurs won the last meeting 127-113 in San Francisco on April 1, 2026.
